incidents.title: Minor Delay in Parcel Delivery
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team,

I would like to raise a minor concern regarding my recent parcel delivery.
The parcel arrived slightly later than the estimated delivery date provided
in the tracking system.

Although I understand that small delays may occasionally happen, I would
appreciate more accurate delivery updates in the future to help customers
plan accordingly.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Yours sincerely,
Nadeeya
incidents.summary: Customer received parcel slightly later than expected delivery date.

incidents.title: Packaging Slightly Damaged During Delivery
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team,

I recently received a parcel delivered through your service and noticed
that the outer packaging was slightly damaged upon arrival. Fortunately,
the item inside was not affected.

I am writing this feedback so that extra care can be taken when handling
parcels in transit to avoid possible damage in future deliveries.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Yours sincerely,
Nadeeya
incidents.summary: Customer received parcel with minor damage, requesting extra care in future deliveries.

incidents.title: Tracking Information Not Updated Promptly
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team,

I would like to provide feedback regarding the tracking system for my
recent parcel delivery. During transit, the tracking information was not
updated regularly, which made it difficult to know the parcel’s current
status.

The parcel was eventually delivered successfully, but more consistent
updates would improve the customer experience and reduce uncertainty.

Thank you for considering this feedback.

Yours sincerely,
Nadeeya
incidents.summary: Customer experienced delayed tracking updates for recent parcel delivery.

incidents.title: Failed Delivery Attempts Without Notification
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team,

I was surprised to see that my parcel was marked as having multiple failed
delivery attempts, despite not receiving any notification or contact from
the courier.

I was available at the address during the stated times, and no attempt was
made to reach me. This raises concerns about the accuracy of the delivery
reporting.

Please arrange for a redelivery and ensure proper communication moving
forward.

Yours sincerely,
Nadeeya
incidents.summary: Customer received no notification despite multiple failed delivery attempts. They were available at the address during stated times.

incidents.title: Overcharged Shipping Fees
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team,

I am writing to raise a concern regarding the shipping charges applied to
my recent parcel. The fees appear to be significantly higher than initially
quoted.

I request a breakdown of the charges and clarification on the discrepancy.
If an error has occurred, I expect a refund for the excess amount paid.

Transparency in pricing is essential, and I hope this matter can be
resolved promptly.

Thank you.

Yours sincerely,
Nadeeya
incidents.summary: Customer claims incorrect shipping charges, requesting refund and pricing clarification.

incidents.title: Complaint Regarding Delayed Delivery
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team at DHL,

I am writing to report a significant delay in the delivery of my parcel.
According to the tracking information, the parcel was expected to arrive
several days ago, but it has yet to be delivered. The delay has caused
inconvenience, as the contents were time-sensitive.

While I understand that unforeseen circumstances may arise, I did not
receive any prior notification or explanation regarding the delay. This
lack of communication has made it difficult to plan accordingly.

I kindly request an update on the current status of my parcel and a clear
explanation for the delay. Additionally, I would appreciate assurance that
appropriate measures are being taken to prevent such issues in the future.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Yours sincerely,
Dee
incidents.summary: Customer experienced significant delay in parcel delivery, causing inconvenience due to time-sensitive contents.

incidents.title: Parcel Stuck in Transit Without Updates
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team,

I am writing to inquire about a parcel that appears to be stuck in transit.
The tracking status has not been updated for several days.

This lack of progress and communication is concerning, as I have no
visibility on when the parcel will arrive.

I request a detailed update on the parcel’s status and expected delivery
timeline. Please also investigate the cause of the delay.

I look forward to your prompt reply.

Yours sincerely,
Azaya
incidents.summary: Parcel not updating, causing concern about delivery timeline.

incidents.title: Unprofessional Behavior of Delivery Personnel
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team at ,

I would like to report an issue regarding the conduct of a delivery
personnel assigned to my recent parcel.

During the delivery, the staff member displayed unprofessional behavior,
including poor communication and lack of courtesy. This created an
uncomfortable experience.

Customer service extends beyond delivery accuracy, and I believe this
matter should be addressed seriously. I request that appropriate action be
taken and that your staff be reminded of expected service standards.

Thank you for your attention.

Yours sincerely,
Azaya
incidents.summary: Customer experienced uncomfortable delivery experience due to unprofessional staff behavior.

incidents.title: Incorrect Item Delivered
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team at DHL,

I recently received a parcel through your service; however, the contents do
not match what I ordered. It appears that the wrong item was delivered.

This error has caused inconvenience and delay in receiving the correct
product. I request guidance on returning the incorrect item and receiving
the correct one as soon as possible.

Please also clarify whether any additional charges will be covered, as this
mistake was not on my part.

I appreciate your prompt response.

Yours sincerely,
Dyazizee
incidents.summary: Customer received wrong item instead of ordered product, causing inconvenience and delay.

incidents.title: Parcel Marked Delivered but Not Received
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team at DHL,

I am contacting you regarding a parcel that has been marked as “delivered”
in your system, despite not being received by me.

I have checked with neighbors and reviewed my surroundings, but the parcel
cannot be located. This raises concerns about the accuracy of the delivery
process.

I request an immediate investigation into this matter and clarification on
where the parcel was delivered. Please advise on the next steps, including
compensation if the parcel cannot be recovered.

Thank you for your assistance.

Yours sincerely,
Aya
incidents.summary: Customer's parcel was marked as delivered but not received, raising concerns about delivery accuracy.

incidents.title: Complaint About Damaged Parcel Upon Arrival
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team at DHL,

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with a parcel I recently
received, which arrived in a damaged condition. The packaging was visibly
crushed, and the item inside was broken and unusable.

This indicates improper handling during transit, which is unacceptable
given the trust placed in your service. I have attached photographic
evidence to support my claim.

I request a prompt resolution, including compensation or replacement for
the damaged item. I also urge your team to review handling procedures to
prevent similar incidents.

I look forward to your response.

Yours sincerely,
Aya
incidents.summary: Customer received a damaged parcel and is requesting compensation or replacement.

incidents.title: Formal Complaint Regarding Incorrect Delivery Address and Compensation Issue
incidents.description:
Dear Customer Service Team at ,

I am writing to formally lodge a complaint regarding a recent delivery
issue involving my parcel, as well as the unsatisfactory handling of my
compensation request. Despite my efforts to resolve this matter through
your standard support channels, I have not received a fair or timely
resolution, which has caused significant inconvenience and frustration.

The parcel in question was assigned a tracking number and was expected to
be delivered to my correct residential address as provided during the
ordering process. However, upon reviewing the delivery status, I discovered
that the parcel had been delivered to an incorrect address. This error is
particularly concerning, as I had ensured that all address details were
accurate and complete at the time of submission. The mistake appears to
have occurred during the handling or delivery stage, which is beyond my
control as a customer.

Following this incident, I immediately contacted your customer service team
to report the issue. While I appreciate the initial response acknowledging
my complaint, the subsequent handling of the situation has been
disappointing. I was informed that an investigation would be conducted, but
the updates provided were minimal and lacked clarity. Furthermore, I was
not given a concrete timeline for resolution, leaving me uncertain about
the status of my parcel.

In addition to the delivery error, I am deeply dissatisfied with the
compensation process. After submitting the required documents, including
proof of purchase and relevant details, I expected a straightforward and
fair assessment of my claim. Instead, I encountered delays, repeated
requests for the same information, and unclear explanations regarding the
eligibility criteria for compensation. At one point, my claim appeared to
be dismissed without sufficient justification, which raises concerns about
the transparency and fairness of your claims procedure.

This situation has not only resulted in the loss of my parcel but has also
consumed a considerable amount of my time and effort. As a customer, I rely
on your services to deliver items accurately and to handle issues
responsibly when they arise. Unfortunately, this experience has fallen
short of those expectations.

I kindly request that your team take immediate action to address the
following matters. First, a thorough investigation should be conducted to
determine how the delivery address error occurred and whether the parcel
can still be retrieved. Second, I ask for a clear and fair reassessment of
my compensation claim, with transparent communication regarding the outcome
and any supporting reasons. Lastly, I would appreciate improved
communication throughout this process, including timely updates and a
designated point of contact to avoid further confusion.

Please treat this matter with urgency and seriousness. I believe that
resolving this issue promptly and fairly will help restore my confidence in
your services. I look forward to your response and a satisfactory
resolution.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Yours sincerely,
Nadeeya
incidents.summary: Customer received parcel delivered to incorrect address and experienced delays in compensation claim resolution.

incidents.title: Incident from Customer WhatsApp message complains
incidents.description:
Customer WhatsApp message complains courier collected RM450 COD instead of RM250 shown on invoice. Customer attached photo of handwritten receipt.
Email from finance later says system reflects RM450 COD amount.
Warehouse note: “COD sticker unclear, handwritten?”
Caller wants refund of extra RM200 urgently. No clarity on who entered wrong COD amount.
incidents.summary: Customer received incorrect COD amount, claiming RM450 instead of RM250.
